acceptance: Set is a value with insertion order preserved, set-theoretic equality and the methods has/add/remove/clear/is_empty/len/to_list/lazy; the Set(list) conversion deduplicates in first-occurrence order (ADP-006 section A)

Sequence is an immutable lazy pipeline over List, Dict values and Set with the vocabulary recorded in ADP-006 section B (map/filter/flat_map/find/any/all/count/reduce/take/skip/group_by/distinct/zip/chain/chunk/window/enumerate/collect), and take short-circuits so it stays bounded

Bytes is a mutable buffer whose read_* and write_* methods pack i8..f64 little-endian, with String.encode() and Bytes.decode() (recoverable Failure on invalid UTF-8) and deterministic faults on exact-index violations
Duration(seconds) accepts Int or Float and supports +, -, relational comparison, equality and total_seconds()

Task and Group are value-level handles registered as contract types and type tags without colliding with user structs of the same name, and the task module exposes spawn/sleep/all/race/timeout/cancel/group
Every new type, method and tag behaves identically on the Rust VM and the JavaScript runtime (differential suite and shim selftest green)
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
